business: Ostlee Noodle Bar is a small family restaurant on Mill Street in Ostlee. It serves hand-pulled noodles and slow-cooked broth to people on a lunch break, families, and anyone picking up dinner on the way home. Daniel and June Seo gave the four facts on the proof strip: the noodles are made by hand every morning, the family has run the bar since 2015, there is a vegetarian broth every day, and walk-ins are welcome with no booking. They also gave three reviews from regulars who agreed to be quoted by first name and last initial, each rated 5 out of 5. Its phone, (555) 555-0175, its email, hello@ostlee-noodle-bar.example.com, and the three figures in its stats row (founded in 2015, an average rating of 4.7, and 529 reviews) are set in Settings > Site Data, so the page binds them and no copy types them.
